One day, a high summer flood washed him out of the burrow where he lived with his father and mother, and carried him, kicking and clucking, down a roadside ditch. He found a little wisp of grass floating there, and clung to it till he lost his senses. arxiv-2212-01887.description: Abstract We consider the performance of the difference-in-means estimator in a two-arm randomized experiment under common experimental endpoints such as continuous (regression), incidence, proportion and survival. arxiv-2405-19686.title: Knowledge Graph Tuning: Real-time Large Language Model Personalization based on Human Feedback
arxiv-2405-19686.creator: Jingwei Sun, Zhixu Du, Yiran Chen
arxiv-2405-19686.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jingwei Sun, Zhixu Du, Yiran Chen. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in a range of natural language processing tasks. Once deployed, LLMs encounter users with personalized factual knowledge, and such personalized knowledge is consistently reflected through users’ interactions with the LLMs. To enhance user experience, real-time model personalization is essential, allowing LLMs to adapt user-specific knowledge based on user feedback during human-LLM interactions. Existing methods mostly require back-propagation to finetune the model parameters, which incurs high computational and memory costs.

arxiv-2405-20264.title: Transmission of multiple pathogens across species
arxiv-2405-20264.creator: Clotilde Djuikem, Julien Arino
arxiv-2405-20264.description: Abstract We analyse a model that describes the propagation of many pathogens within and between many species. A branching process approximation is used to compute the probability of disease outbreaks. Special cases of aquatic environments with two host species and one or two pathogens are considered both analytically and computationally.

arxiv-2506-00088.description: Abstract In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable advancements, yet hallucination, where models produce inaccurate or non-factual statements, remains a significant challenge for real-world deployment. Although current classification-based methods, such as SAPLMA, are highly efficient in mitigating hallucinations, they struggle when non-factual information arises in the early or mid-sequence of outputs, reducing their reliability.

Despite this complexity, models should be interpretable to aid clinicians in understanding an individual’s risk prediction. Readmissions are often heterogeneous, as individuals hospitalized for different reasons, particularly across distinct clinical diagnosis groups, exhibit materially different subsequent risks of readmission.

pmc-11700380.creator: Parnika P Saxena, Adam Turnbull, Daniel Kim, Barbara Sommer, F Vankee Lin

pmc-11975517.title: 牙周辅助加速成骨正畸治疗的研究进展
pmc-11975517.creator: 奕宸 熊, 珺 陈, 文杰 李
pmc-11975517.description: 牙周辅助加速成骨正畸治疗(periodontally accelerated osteogenic orthodontics，PAOO)是正畸治疗的辅助手段，其基础原理为“局部加速现象”，即通过促进破骨细胞的活动达到加速正畸治疗的目的。在临床应用上，其手术方法近年来逐步优化，包括压电骨皮质切开术、牙槽骨微穿孔术等新术式的应用。所使用的材料也逐渐改良，包括生物活性玻璃等新型移植材料和富血小板纤维蛋白膜等新型屏障膜。正是由于这些临床创新的涌现，PAOO正朝着低痛苦、低损伤、高疗效的方向发展。但是，目前关于PAOO的临床研究尚少，未来仍需大样本、多中心的随机对照试验来评价不同术式、不同植骨材料等对PAOO临床疗效的影响。 牙周辅助加速成骨正畸治疗(periodontally accelerated osteogenic orthodontics，PAOO)是在传统的正畸治疗中，加入了切开牙槽骨骨皮质的措施，从而达到加速正畸牙移动的目的[1]。PAOO在最初被提出时，是一种仅包含翻瓣手术后骨皮质切开操作的正畸加速手术。然而，鉴于其会对患者的牙槽骨造成较大损伤，且会引起诸多不良反应，此手术方法未能得以推广。随着其在临床应用中被不断改良，以Wilcko团队[2]将植骨引入该手术为标志，当下广义的PAOO还包括了植骨、放膜等一系列步骤，兼具改善牙周状况、重塑牙槽骨的功能，较大程度减小了手术的风险。因此，如今广义的PAOO不仅可以加速正畸牙移动，也可以实现牙槽骨与牙龈软组织增厚，减少正畸并发症，扩大正畸治疗适应范围。在中国预期接受正畸治疗与已经接受治疗的患者中，因人种的原因有较大比例患者存在骨开窗、骨开裂等骨缺损情况[3]。因此，PAOO在中国具有较大的临床应用前景。 本文旨在系统综述PAOO的临床及基础研究进展，以期深入探讨该技术的作用机制、临床应用及未来发展方向，提高临床医师、研究人员对其的认知水平，促进其在临床实践和科研探索中的应用与发展。 PAOO技术基础原理概述 PAOO及其衍生改良后的手术方式的基础原理皆源自Frost[4]于1983年提出的“局部加速现象”(regional acceleratory phenomenon，RAP)理论。该技术借助骨皮质切开这一手术方式，破坏牙槽骨骨质，刺激牙周组织内产生炎症反应，成骨细胞核因子κB配体受体(receptor activator for nuclear factor-κB ligand，RANKL)表达升高，其与破骨前体细胞表面的RANK结合，诱导术区破骨前体细胞成熟[5]，并且使成骨细胞相关因子表达增加，如骨钙蛋白、骨钙素、载脂蛋白A-I(apolipoprotein A-I，APOA-I)等[6-7]，进而降低术区骨密度，一定程度上减少了正畸牙移动的阻力，实现加速正畸牙移动。 PAOO后的生理学机制是该领域的研究热点，目前提出了PAOO的多种机制。Zhang等[8]提出，在PAOO后，由于miRNA-21表达水平升高，程序性细胞死亡因子4(programmed cell death 4，PDCD4)基因表达降低，导致c-Fos蛋白水平升高，RANKL介导的破骨细胞生成增强，牙槽骨重塑，牙槽骨骨质暂时性减少，正畸牙移动加快。Wang等[9]的研究表明，miRNA-21通过抑制磷酸酯酶与张力蛋白同源物(phosphatase and tensin homolog，PTEN)对磷脂酰肌醇3激酶/蛋白激酶B(phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase/protein kinase B，PI3K/Akt)信号转导通路的抑制作用，从而加快破骨细胞生成，促进在PAOO后正畸牙的加速移动。Kinjo等[10]对于牙槽骨微穿孔术(micro-osteoperforations，MOPs)的研究表明：在骨皮质受到刺激后，牙周韧带细胞会产生大量炎症因子，如肿瘤坏死因子-α(tumor necrosis factor-α，TNF-α)等，这些炎症因子可刺激基质细胞提高RANKL的生成量，从而诱导破骨细胞的生成，加速正畸牙移动(图1)。以上研究大致勾勒出了PAOO后的牙周物质变化以及部分物质对于加速正畸治疗的生物学作用，然而还需要进一步探究术后牙周组织变化情况以完全阐明PAOO的完整生物学机制。 PAOO效果通路示意图 Figure 1 Illustration of the PAOO effect pathway APOA1: Apolipoprotein A1; pmc-12757563.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryCryptochromes (CRYs) play critical roles in regulating diverse physiological functions, including circadian rhythms and neuronal firing in light-dependent or -independent fashions. Structural studies of CRYs have highlighted common features, such as the photolyase homology region (PHR), but they also reveal key differences, particularly in the binding of the flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) cofactor, leading to a long-standing debate, namely, whether Type I CRYs can function as FAD-dependent photosensors.
